description: This chart illustrates the GLUE performance of various fine-tuning methods for RoBERTa-base and RoBERTa-large models. The horizontal axis represents different fine-tuning methods, listed in the order: Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S1-model, S4-model, and S5-model, while the vertical axis represents GLUE performance, ranging from approximately 85 to 89, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 1. The chart features grouped bars, with blue bars representing RoBERTa-base and orange bars representing RoBERTa-large, for each fine-tuning method. The bars are grouped by fine-tuning method, with the RoBERTa-base and RoBERTa-large bars appearing side by side for each method. The GLUE performance values for RoBERTa-base range from approximately 85 to 87, with the lowest value observed for BitFit and the highest for LoRA, while the values for RoBERTa-large range from around 86 to 89, with the lowest value observed for S1-model and the highest for S5-model. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the fine-tuning methods, and no bars are visually emphasized.
